identity: Existing enabled Admin only; user completes Microsoft/MFA in connected browser

session_operations.records_allowed: Only that login transaction/session, OIDC rate bucket and corresponding authentication audit/revocation records

governance_requests.policy: Existing active policy only; no policy update or activation
governance_requests.records_allowed: Up to four synthetic execution records and associated usage/rate-limit/audit records; at most one incidental review if an unexpected HUMAN_REVIEW result occurs, then stop; do not assign/resolve existing reviews

prohibited: deleting or editing existing application records
read_only_fallback: If provider failure, show already existing history/analytics/review/export metadata; no additional generation or simulation

policy_simulation.records_allowed: One policy simulation audit plus its usage/rate-limit records
policy_simulation.semantics: Simulates selected current draft; do not claim it verifies active published policy unless parity is independently established

preflight: Before any write, reconfirm same release/revision, signed-in Admin, active policy and rules; stop if mismatched. Check model pricing against USD1 estimate before provider calls.
